title: createNestedRouter
summary: Create a client-side router with persistent nested layouts.

sections.title: Create
sections.body: Use the same nested entry for the provider, outlet and layout data hooks. React uses the equivalent /react/nested import.
sections.code:
import { createNestedRouter } from "@kasperrt/smolter/preact/nested";
const router = createNestedRouter(routes, { browser: true, basename: "/platform" });

sections.title: Route definitions
sections.body: Each route has an ID, absolute path pattern, optional parentId and route module exports. File routing infers these identities. Parent loaders run alongside child loaders. Layout state remains mounted across matching descendants.

sections.title: Targeted refresh
sections.body: An explicit target does not cascade to ancestors or descendants. Each targeted module can veto refreshing its existing loader value with shouldRevalidate.

sections.title: Lifetime and scope
sections.body: Dispose the router on unmount. This optional adapter is for client-only applications; nested SSR transport and hydration integration are not provided. Existing flat routers remain unchanged.

sections.title: Loading and transitions
sections.body: Layouts without loaders stay mounted while a child loader is pending. The loading child owns its HydrateFallback. Smolter does not start or configure animations. An optional configureApplication commitRoute callback lets the consumer wrap a route-view commit; it works with both flat mounted applications and nested adapters.
